text.en:
The Judicial and Bar Council as provided
for under Section 8(1), Article VIII, of the 1987 Constitu-
tion Is hereby declared to be now in existence.

The Judicial and Bar Council created under
the supervision of the Supreme Court shall be composed of
the Chief Justice as ex-officio Chairman, the Secretary of
Justice, and a representative of the Congress as ex-officio
Malibers, a representative of the Integrated Bar, a professor
ol law, a retired member of the Supreme Court, and a repre-
Sentative of the private sector.

The regular Menbers of the Council shall
be appointed by the President for a term of four vears with
the consent of the Commission on Appointments.
Members first appointed, the representative of the Integrated
Bar shall serve for four years, the professor of law for threp
years, the retired Justice for two years, and the regresenta-
tive of the private sector for one year.

The Clerk of Court of the Supreme Court
shall be the Secretary ex-officio of the Council and shall
keep a record of its proceedings.

The regular Members of the Council shall
receive such emoluments as may be determined by the Supreme
Court. The Supreme Court shall provide in its annual budget
the appropriations for the Council.

The Council shall have the principal function
of recommending appointees to the Judiciary. It may exercise
such other functions and duties as the Supreme Court may assign

- 2 -

All laws, orders, issuances, rules and
regulations or parts thereof inconsistent with this Execu-
tive Order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect
immediately.
Done In the City of Manila, this 10th day of July,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-seven.
By the President:
JOKER P. ARROYO
Executive Secretary
